source: neutral b-decomp to accompany clean residual profile (2026-05-31)
notes: Supersedes the old 2-step-fitted b_decomp whose per-sp residual `a` and
large per-sp K_step (441-745ms) were overfit artifacts (see
CLEAN_PROFILE_FINDINGS.md). The validated model needs NO per-step K_step:
fwd_backward = attn_LUT + a*tokens + b(small), all per-group inside max.
This profile is intentionally NEUTRAL: it does NOT override residual a/b
(no residual_per_sp), and sets per-step constants to ~0 so the clean
measured separately in timings_ms and only added when predicting
